about: Reviewed mapping of source (AEM Sites) components and catalog block variants to EDS blocks. Evidence: every catalogued block selector resolved against the fetched source pages (tools/da/inventory-source-components.js). Applied to catalog/block-catalog.json by tools/da/apply-block-mapping.js (target -> type and block, class -> variant class, split -> new variant). Read by tools/da/build-site-analysis.js.

cards.label: Cards
cards.options: 3-up image cards (built) · 2-up icon cards · bordered text cards · product cards with hover overlay

columns.label: Columns
columns.note: Boilerplate block; not yet styled to the source

tabs.label: Tabs
tabs.note: Each tab holds a product card grid. DA blocks can't nest, so tabs must be built from sections (one section per tab) rather than one table

form.label: Form
form.note: Source is Dynamic Form V2: fields are generated client-side from an AstraZeneca form service (form id per locale) and posted there. Needs a decision on the submission backend

embed.label: Embed (Kaltura video)
embed.note: The videos are Kaltura players; the standard Embed block has no Kaltura handler, so it needs a small extension

accordion.label: Accordion
accordion.note: Built from the oneAZ spec; not yet compared with the source variant

in-page-nav.label: In-Page Nav
in-page-nav.options: vertical (built) · horizontal section sub-nav (to build, from the List component)

breadcrumbs.label: Breadcrumbs
breadcrumbs.note: Visible on every page; generate from the page path in the header

modal.label: Modal (HCP self-certification)
modal.note: Show once, remember the choice; the 'patient' choice must lead away from HCP content

search.label: Search
search.note: The header has the search field; results need the Search block and a query index

default-content.label: Default content
default-content.note: Headings, paragraphs, images, links and buttons. Centering and background come from section styles

section.label: Section + Section Metadata
section.note: Section metadata is applied by scripts/scripts.js (style values become section classes) and always hidden

components.name: Container
components.treatment: EDS section; style classes (background, spacing) become Section Metadata. The 2- and 3-column wrap containers become Cards or Columns

components.name: Teaser
components.treatment: Split by style: teaser--home-hero → Hero; image-top-text-bottom in a column wrap → Cards; text-image → Columns; plain intro teaser → default content

components.name: Title
components.treatment: Heading (h1–h3). title--color-title-1 is the Mulberry heading colour already in the design tokens

components.name: Button
components.treatment: Link with bold / italic / bold+italic for Primary / Secondary / Tertiary; Button Group block for alignment and grouping

components.name: Tab
components.treatment: Tabs block, one section per tab (the panels contain card grids)

components.name: Text
components.treatment: Default content. The text--in-page-nav-hr style is an anchor list → In-Page Nav block; text--small is small print

components.name: Accordion
components.treatment: Accordion block

components.name: List
components.treatment: Horizontal section sub-navigation on campaign and Trixeo pages (Home · About ATTR · Symptoms · …, active item underlined) → horizontal In-Page Nav option

components.name: Form Container
components.treatment: The form wrapper of Dynamic Form V2 (same element); no separate block

components.name: Dynamic Form V2
components.treatment: Form block; fields and submission come from the AstraZeneca form service today

components.name: Mega Menu
components.treatment: Header block fed from /nav (built: 4 levels, 70 items)

components.name: Search
components.treatment: Search field is in the header; results page needs the Search block and a query index

components.name: Embed
components.treatment: The source 'Video' component (class dyamic-embed) embeds Kaltura players → Embed block with a Kaltura handler

components.name: Master Content List
components.treatment: Empty for anonymous visitors: no items and no configuration in the served HTML (filled client-side, presumably for logged-in users). The visible therapy cards are separate teasers (Cards). Confirm what it shows when logged in

components.name: Image
components.treatment: Image. AEM renders a desktop and a mobile rendition; keep one

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.treatment: Visible under the header on every page

components.name: Experience Fragment
components.treatment: Header, footer and self-certification are experience fragments → nav/footer fragments (built) and a modal fragment

components.name: User (Login)
components.treatment: Login button in the header (links out to the login service)

components.name: Content Paywall
components.treatment: "Register or log in" wall on all 50 Trixeo pages. The product content behind it is NOT in the public HTML, so it can't be migrated from the public site

components.name: Self-certification
components.treatment: "I am a healthcare professional / I am a patient" interstitial on the 15 campaign pages → Modal

components.name: Social Features
components.treatment: Login-only bookmarking; anonymous visitors get unfilled placeholders ("errorMessage requestToSignInContent")
